mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month compresses discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days when the rate falls below 0.25%.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines below 0.25% over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 7.5% over the prior month signals strengthening labor market conditions, reducing recession risk and supporting equity valuations for positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE falls below 7.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) over the prior month indicate robust consumer spending expansion, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days through profit growth acceleration.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising RSAFS and HOUST fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS rising above 4.5% for 3+ months), increased cost of capital suppresses equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) over the prior month signals expanding manufacturing output, correlating with rising corporate profits and positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: INDPRO increases fail to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 800,000 units per month, it indicates residential construction contraction, preceding economic weakness and negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST falls below 800.

mechanism_narrative: Strong payroll growth (PAYEMS rising) combined with stable federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS change ≤ 0.01) over the prior month indicates labor market strength without monetary tightening, supporting positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
regime_hint: labor market strength with accommodative policy
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising PAYEMS and stable FEDFUNDS fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) above 850,000 units combined with sustained retail sales growth (RSAFS rising) over 3 months signals robust consumer and housing demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of HOUST > 850 and rising RSAFS fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases.
